commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: - Verified end-to-end via a throwaway spike page (`getCollection('docs')`/`getCollection('blog')`, built and inspected the static HTML output, then deleted): 18 docs resolved with correct `id`s, exactly 10 flagged `hasExplainer: true` (matching `EXPLAINER_SOLVERS`), 1 blog post resolved with the right title. `npx astro sync`, `npx astro check` (0 errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests), and `npm run build:check` (existing Vite site) all pass.

- Note: running `npm run build:check` for verification regenerated the committed `teeline-web/algorithms/<id>/index.html` files (pre-existing generated output that's checked into git) with cosmetic diffs from the new frontmatter shifting `extractMeta()`'s output slightly — reverted those via `git checkout` since they were an incidental verification byproduct, not intended Phase 2 changes. Worth remembering for future verification runs on this branch.

- Next: Phase 3 (static content pages) — `BaseLayout.astro`, `Topbar.astro`, `AlgorithmCards.astro`, `FeatureCards.astro`, then `index.astro`, `tsp/`, `webmcp/`, `api-key/`. This is also where Astro 7's stricter markup validation risk first surfaces.
- **Phase 3 (static content pages) — done.** All 4 pages (home, `/tsp/`, `/webmcp/`, `/api-key/`) ported and verified working end-to-end.

- Built `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro` (html/head/meta/OG/canonical + PicoCSS + docs.css imports + `<Topbar />`), `src/components/Topbar.astro` (server-rendered from `nav-data.ts`, dropdown close-on-outside-click as a small inline `<script>`), `src/components/AlgorithmCards.astro` and `FeatureCards.astro` (direct ports of `algorithm-cards.mjs`/`feature-cards.mjs`, `set:html` for the inline SVG icons).
- **Markup validation risk did NOT materialize** — Astro 7's stricter HTML validation flagged zero errors across all 4 hand-authored pages. Contrary to the pre-emptive risk callout in the plan.

- **Real bug found and fixed via build-output inspection, not caught by `astro check`/`tsc`**: `<script type="module" src="../main.ts"></script>` (the natural HTML-authoring instinct, matching the old `index.html` pattern) is **not** bundled by Astro — it passes through to the static output completely unprocessed (literal `src="../main.ts"` in the shipped HTML, which 404s in a browser; this would have silently broken the entire WASM/worker/solve pipeline in production while every automated check stayed green). Fixed by switching to Astro's documented pattern: an inline `<script>import '../main.ts'</script>` — Vite then correctly bundles it into `/_astro/index...js` and the worker chunk shows up in `dist/_astro/`. **Lesson for Phase 4/6 (more pages with scripts)**: always inspect the actual built HTML output (`grep` the script tags in `dist/*/index.html`), don't just trust a clean `astro check`/`astro build` exit code — this class of bug produces zero compiler/type errors.

- `main.ts` edited: removed `initTopbar()` call and its import (Astro's `Topbar.astro` now owns both the server-render and the click-outside script; leaving the old call in would have client-side JS wipe the SSR'd 18-solver topbar and replace it with the stale 17-solver `nav-html.mjs` version at runtime — actively wrong, not just redundant). Deliberately **kept** the CSS side-effect imports (`pico.min.css`, `main.css`, `docs.css`) in `main.ts` even though `BaseLayout.astro`/`index.astro` now also import them — Vite dedupes by resolved module id so there's no double-bundling, and keeping them avoids breaking the still-live Vite pipeline's homepage styling (which has no other source for those imports).

- Verified end-to-end with Playwright against `astro build` + `astro preview` (not just dev): full solve flow (load `berlin52` example → Continue → select NN solver → Run Solver → real result `8980.9` displayed) worked with zero console errors. All 3 content pages (`/tsp/`, `/webmcp/`, `/api-key/`) render with correct titles, 18 topbar algorithm links each, zero console errors; `/webmcp/`'s Chrome-version-detection badge correctly read Playwright's Chromium as "✓ Chrome 149 detected". The one console 404 seen (`/tunnel`) is the Sentry proxy Cloudflare Pages Function, which doesn't exist under local `astro preview` — expected, not a regression (same gap existed under `vite preview`).
- Re-verified the still-live Vite pipeline (`npm run build:check`) still builds successfully after the `main.ts` edit.
- `npx astro check` (0 errors, same 1 pre-existing unrelated hint), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests) all still pass.

- Next: Phase 4 (doc pages) — `DocsLayout.astro`, `Sidebar.astro`, `src/pages/algorithms/[id]/index.astro` + `getStaticPaths`, Shiki syntax highlighting (verify `rs`→`rust` lang-id mapping), CSS-only first-table styling (replacing the custom marked table renderer), confirm/fix the `dist/_astro/` vs `dist/assets/` asset-directory-name question flagged back in Phase 0 for `copy-wasm.mjs`/`public/_headers`.

commit.message:
Log Phase 3 (static content pages) completion for Astro migration

All 4 pages ported and verified end-to-end via Playwright against
astro build + preview: full solve flow works, all content pages
render correctly. Astro 7's markup validation flagged zero issues
(the pre-emptive risk didn't materialize). Found and fixed a real bug
invisible to astro check/tsc: <script src="../main.ts"> silently
passes through unbundled in Astro (must use inline <script>import>
instead) — would have 404'd the entire WASM pipeline in production
while every automated check stayed green.

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
